bugs.closed_why: The commit rewrote SUBS's \inferrule documentation in include/cvc5/cvc5_proof_rule.h to name the third argument ida alongside t and ids; re-reading that comment and BuiltinProofRuleChecker::checkInternal on main, the documented argument arity is now (3, 1) against the checker's Assert(1 <= args.size() && args.size() <= 3) and its args[2] read, so the recorded disagreement no longer holds.
